description: When a digital ATIS broadcast heard at a time stops being the airport's: 75 minutes after it was heard: the hourly update AIM 4-1-13 asks, and a quarter hour for it to come ('ATIS broadcast must be updated upon the receipt of any official hourly and special weather'); a new letter writes over it before then.

heard.description: When it was heard, Unix seconds.

ends.description: When it is no longer the airport's, Unix seconds.
